testcase.name: Scenario: Show dimensions from an extrusion row: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:663:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show dimensions from an extrusion row ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a rectangular block in the MCAD Software is made by an extrusion of a dimensioned sketch ✔ And the feature dimensions are not displayed ✔ When the user chooses Show Dimensions from the extrusion row context menu ✔ Then dimension annotations appear around the block ✔ And the extrusion row and block edges are highlighted ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the selection highlight clears and the dimensions remain displayed ✔ When the user right-clicks the extrusion row ✔ Then the dimensions disappear and the extrusion context menu opens ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the context menu closes and the shaded block remains visible
